Four pilots · 2026

Proof, one problem at a time.

One measurable outcome each. The result is published either way.

  1. 01Healthy AthletesHealth
  2. 02Clean Data CentersEnergy
  3. 03Infant MortalityHealth
  4. 04Career PathwaysEducation

01Special OlympicsHealth · 3–12 months

Healthy Athletes

A free screening becomes real follow-up care.

Problem
Screenings find the problem. Care rarely follows.
Approach
An app that carries the result home.
Goal
Follow-up care completed within ninety days.

02Governor Jay InsleeEnergy · 3–12 months

Clean Data Centers

States negotiate the buildout instead of absorbing it.

Problem
Data centers arrive before states set terms.
Approach
A playbook for the negotiating table.
Goal
Those terms inside one state siting agreement.

03Butler UniversityHealth · 3–12 months

Infant Mortality

Risk found early, in the weeks that decide outcomes.

Problem
Among the nation’s highest infant mortality rates.
Approach
Maternal health data read for early risk.
Goal
Weeks of warning, in a model other cities can run.

04Secretary Miguel CardonaEducation · 3–12 months

Career Pathways

Guidance that follows a student from school to work.

Problem
The least counseling, the largest choices.
Approach
Guidance built with districts, school to work.
Goal
More students land in a defined pathway.
